pack-all.//: Packs all packable projects in the workspace. src/ lands in dist/packages/ (flat); others go under dist/packages/<relative-path>/

_inject_template_version.//: Stamps the current Directory.Build.props version into all starter template.json files

_inject_flowthru_skill.//: Copies the canonical Flowthru SKILL.md into each starter template before packing. The bare SKILL.md lands at the template root with no tooling opinion — end users move it to .claude/skills/flowthru/, .github/skills/flowthru/, or wherever their agent harness expects.

commands: for dir in examples/starter/*/; do cp .claude/skills/flowthru/SKILL.md "$dir"; done
